note: The name upper is a registered helper, so the classifier accepts the call and J1 yields a {__helper} envelope; but the binding comes from a project file, not the host, and revival will not substitute the host's upper for the one the file imported. The file falls back. A registered name keeps its meaning (F-Eval-CallLocal is checked after the registered shapes), which is why this is not simply a project-local call. local.ts would fold on its own; app.ts imports it and runs, so the forward edge (F-Succ) takes it along.
